# powerdns_zone_export (Data Source)

Exports a zone as a zone file.

For backups and for diffing against a file kept in version control. The whole zone lands in state, so this is not something to run against a zone with thousands of records on every refresh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# For backups, and for diffing against a file kept in version control. The
# whole zone lands in state, so this is not something to run against a zone
# with thousands of records on every refresh.
data "powerdns_zone_export" "backup" {
  zone = "example.com."
}

resource "local_file" "zone_backup" {
  filename = "${path.module}/backups/example.com.zone"
  content  = data.powerdns_zone_export.backup.zone_file
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone to export.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The canonical zone name.
- `zone_file` (String) The zone in presentation format, tabs and newlines included.
